notes.title: PAW Patrol: Rescue Wheels Championship | Announce Trailer
notes.content: [p]Start your engines — the Pups are back and ready to race! 🚗💨 Get the whole family in on the fun with PAW Patrol Rescue Wheels: Championship! [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="DiqtxsLc3DU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Choose your child’s favorite Pup (or even a playful villain!) and race through Adventure Bay, Foggy Bottom, and the Jungle. Kids can perform exciting stunts, drift around the track, and use each Pup’s unique power-up to chase down victory — all in a safe, family-friendly racing game. 🏆🎮 [/p][p]Play solo or enjoy split-screen co-op for even more fun with friends and family! 🐾 [/p][p]Buckle up & get ready for a PAWsome race! [/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/hashtag/pawpatrol"]#PAWPatrol[/url] [url="https://www.youtube.com/hashtag/pawpatrolrescuewheels"]#PAWPatrolRescueWheels[/url][/p]
